notes: Home read on the canonical domain https://digitail.io/ (redirects to digitail.com, the domain the answers cite). Seven own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin. The plans page names the Mobile, Growth, Growth AI and Enterprise tiers and shows no dollar amount anywhere, so all dollar figures, the per-DVM basis and 'quote-based' are unverifiable; C06 (plans page shows tiers but no prices) is classed true on the page itself (judgement call). The 'Brick & Mortar' plan (C09) is not on the current plans page, but with no prices and no dated change it is unverifiable, not wrong or stale. '10,000+ teams' (C22) is unverifiable because the site counts veterinarians, not teams; '10,000 veterinary professionals' (C23) and '30+ integrations' (C24) are true as lower bounds of the published 10,000+ veterinarians and 40+ integrations. App names Pawly and Pawp (C30, C31) are unverifiable rather than wrong (judgement call). No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Feature counts (15+ or 20+ AI workflows), uptime figures, telemedicine, data migration and support descriptions were treated as features or quality, not statements. Hedged pricing lines in Perplexity answers ('per-vet or quote-based pricing depending on source') were not coded. 'Pet Parent App' as a name was coded only within the platform claim C02, not as a separate naming claim. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshot exists for Digitail and no claim was unverifiable because of a blocked page; the other snapshots settle none of the unverifiable claims, and no claim is wrong or stale, so nothing was re-classed. Completeness: added C33 (pricing is transparent; true on the Tails AI page FAQ, judgement call) from the q1 Claude run 1 bottom line, with the q8 Google AI Overviews run 2 line split so it is also a C07 instance; added the q2 Claude run 3 line 'one of the simpler cloud systems to learn' to C01. Table cells (~$300/mo, Per-vet subscription, Contact for pricing, Custom, Quote-based, Cloud, 40+ partners, 30+, Per-DVM) were already instances. Left out: the 'Built-in tools: Everything + VoIP' cell in q8 Claude run 1 (a feature list; VoIP is an add-on per C21), hedged lines ('may require additional costs', 'appears to position itself in the mid-range', 'more accessible entry point'), migration from Avimark and Cornerstone (data migration, not an integration), ratings and best-for lines. For the reviewer: the q6 Google AI Overviews run 2 answer (in the DaySmart Vet bundle, not this one) has an unnamed 'Best AI-Native Platform' section with 'plans start around $289/month'; it does not name Digitail, so it was not coded here.
